feedback: The current robot design has shown significant issues with line loss, evidenced by 2 line loss events in the last trials. The telemetry indicates that the robot is frequently off track, with a maximum error of 0.061435 and a control effort of 1.026406. To improve performance, I recommend adjusting the sensor positions to be more centered and increasing the wheel track to enhance stability during turns. Specifically, I suggest moving the sensor positions to [-0.02, 0.05], [0.0, 0.05], and [0.02, 0.05] and increasing the wheel track to 0.16.
